list.title: Configured Trunks
list.description: Each trunk represents a connection to a SIP provider. Add your carrier credentials to start making calls.
list.emptyDescription: Add a SIP trunk to connect to your telecom provider and start making cost-effective calls.

info.title: How SIP Trunks Work
info.body: A SIP trunk connects {appName} to your telecom provider (e.g. STC, Mobily, Zain in Saudi Arabia, or global providers like Telnyx and Bandwidth). Once configured, assign it to a phone number on the Phone Numbers page, then your AI agents will place and receive calls through the trunk, no Twilio required.
info.requirements: Requirements: Asterisk must be installed on your server. After adding or modifying trunks, click "Reload Asterisk" to apply the configuration.

dialog.manualHint: Configure host, port, and credentials without using a preset.
dialog.transportHint: Check your provider's docs. Most use UDP.
dialog.dialPrefixHint: Optional tech prefix added before the number when dialling

debug.title: SIP Debug
debug.description: Diagnose SIP problems without SSH access — health checks run on the server, and call events stream below.
debug.endpointNotLoaded: Endpoint not loaded — calls will fail with "Allocation failed". Click "Reload Asterisk".
debug.providerUnreachable: Provider unreachable — calls will fail with "Allocation failed". Usually a wrong transport/port for this provider (e.g. Twilio needs UDP 5060 or TLS 5061, not TCP).
debug.providerNotQualified: Provider not qualified yet (no OPTIONS ping result)
debug.noContact: No contact registered for this trunk in Asterisk. Click "Reload Asterisk".
debug.healthFailed: Could not load health checks. Is the backend running?
debug.noEvents: No SIP events yet. Make a test call or reload Asterisk — events will appear here.
